spans.s:
शैव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Relating or appertaining to the god ŚIVA.
 m.
(-वः) A worshipper of ŚIVA.
 n. (-वं) An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria
octandra.)
 E. शिव the deity, and अण् aff.

शैवल m. (-लः) An aquatic plant, moss.
 n. (-लं) A drug, commonly
termed Padma-kāth.
 E. शी to sleep, (on the water,) वलञ् aff.;
also शैवाल शेवाल, &c.

शैवाल m. (-लः) An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria octandra.)
 E. शी to sleep,
(on the water,) वालञ् aff., शेवाल and अण् pleonasm.
सैवाल n. (-लं) Name of an aquatic plant: see शैवाल ।

शैवलिनी f. (-नी) A river in general.
 E. शैवल Vallisneria, and इनि aff.

शैव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्यी-व्यं) Relating to ŚIVA, &c.
 m. (-व्यः)
 1. One of the
four horses of KṚṢṆA'S car.
 2. A horse in general.
 3. A king
and champion in the Pāṇḍava's army.
 E. शिव, and यञ् aff.
